sources.title: CNN-ViT: A multi-feature learning based approach for driver drowsiness ...
sources.snippet: First, this study introduces a novel hybrid architecture that integrates CNNs from the base model with ViT in a parallel dual-stream framework. Unlike previous work that uses CNNs or ViTs independently, this model fuses local spatial features and global contextual information in a unified framework for driver drowsiness detection.

sources.snippet: The paper is organized as follows: Section 2 describes the literature related to drowsiness detection; Section 3 describes the materials and methods used; Section 4 shows the results obtained and their analysis for each CNN architecture, obtaining a model for each. Finally, Section 5 presents the conclusions and future research.
